user.title: Deckhand Smart Dial
user.description: Enter your team ID to discover Deckhand dials via MQTT. Helm: the team id shown in Helm settings. Deckhand Console: `local`.

reconfigure.title: Change Deckhand team
reconfigure.description: This entry currently listens on deckhand/{current_team_id}/…. Enter the team ID to move it to — for example `local` when the dials have moved from Helm to Deckhand Console. The entry, its dial and Room devices, and their entities are kept, so automations that target them keep working. Move every dial first: after saving, Home Assistant only hears dials on the new team.

data_description.team_id: One MQTT topic level: letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Helm uses its numeric team id; Deckhand Console uses `local`.

finish.title: Deckhand is ready

error.invalid_team_id: Enter a team ID of letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (no spaces, '/', '+' or '#').
error.team_id_in_use: Another Deckhand entry already uses this team ID. Remove that entry first, or pick a different team.

abort.already_configured: Deckhand is already configured for this team.
abort.mqtt_not_configured: MQTT integration is not configured. Please set up MQTT first.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Team changed. The integration reloaded and now listens on the new team.
abort.reconfigure_entry_missing: The Deckhand entry to reconfigure no longer exists.

init.title: Deckhand options
init.description: Manage which media_player entities auto-push now-playing updates to your dials.

add.title: Add media_player binding
add.description: Pick a Deckhand dial and the media_player entity it should mirror. When the player state changes, the dial's now-playing face updates automatically. Currently configured: {count}.

remove.title: Remove bindings
remove.description:
Pick one or more bindings to delete:
{bindings}

summary.title: Dials, blueprints and docs

error.missing_fields: Both a dial and a media_player entity are required.
error.not_media_player: The selected entity must be a media_player.
error.unknown_dial: The selected device is not a Deckhand dial on this integration.

unknown_device.message: The selected device is not a known Deckhand dial.

invalid_theme.message: A non-empty theme id is required.

invalid_bindings.message: Provide a non-empty bindings array. Each binding needs at least an id.

binding_id_too_long.message: Binding id "{id}" is longer than {max} characters. The dial matches live state by the whole id, so a longer one would never update.

invalid_states.message: Provide a non-empty states array. Each entry needs an id and at least one of state/value/event.

invalid_layer.message: layer must be "ring" (the Perimeter Ring overlay) or "pulse" (a retired alias for the same ring).

invalid_sequence.message: Provide a non-empty sequence. Each step needs an id.

art_entity_not_media_player.message: {entity_id} is not a media player. An Art Gallery (ha_art) menu item selects one of a media player's sources, so set action_data.entity_id to a media_player entity. Nothing was sent to the dial.

menu_item_entity_wrong_domain.message: {entity_id} cannot be the entity of a {item_type} menu item. Set action_data.entity_id to a {domains} entity. Nothing was sent to the dial.

firmware_too_old.title: Update {dial}'s firmware
firmware_too_old.description: {dial} runs firmware {version}, which ignores something an automation or service asked of it: {features}. The command was sent but the dial did nothing with it. Update the dial to firmware {required} or later from Helm or Deckhand Console; this notice clears by itself on the dial's first check-in on new enough firmware.

dial_offline.title: {dial} has been offline for {hours} hours
dial_offline.description: Home Assistant has not heard from {dial} for {hours} hours, so its automations, announcements and timers are not reaching it. Check that it has power and Wi-Fi (a dial that cannot join Wi-Fi shows its setup screen). This notice clears by itself when the dial checks in again; if the dial is gone for good, remove it in Helm or Deckhand Console.

confirm.title: Import the Deckhand blueprints

error.still_missing: No Deckhand blueprint is in config/blueprints/automation yet. Import one with a link above, then submit again.

update_from_media_player.name: Update from media player
update_from_media_player.description: Read a media_player's current state and push it to a dial as a now-playing update.
